title: Recast: Enabling User Recourse and Interpretability of Toxicity Detection Models with Interactive Visualization

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of user open-ended responses and interactions with the RECAST tool to identify the model's tendency to disproportionately flag specific keywords, slang, and regional dialects (e.g., British English) as toxic despite benign semantic intent.

Quantitative comparison of human-perceived toxicity versus model-classified toxicity on original and user-edited comments, demonstrating the divergence between algorithmic proxy measures and human judgments of toxicity.
